mission.title: Intruder
mission.description: Find the missing Agents and question the witnesses to a strange glowing intruder.

npc.say: This seems awfully disorganized. I just want to know what you plan to do about that freak. Hmh!

No, I never have fainting spells. Really. I think this thing could be dangerous. That's why I called. Did I... Do you think you can get it?
Okay, okay.
Hey, uh... Is cleaning up these... Will that be tax deductible?

phase.briefing: Operative, some of our Agents appear to have encountered a...problem. They are no longer responding. I would like you to locate them.

enter.say:
Soo... Is this what happens when their warranty expires?
Well, that's the place you're supposed to check. Good luck.

done.say:
Uh-oh...
Running a scan to see if I can find anything that might... Hm... There's a weird residual signal... Just bits, but they don't fit a known code profile.
Whatever it is, we'd better let Gray know that we found the missing Agents.

phase.briefing:
I see.
Very well, {player}. I did not want to involve you in the investigation, but it appears that I have little choice.
Ettie Watson just called emergency services to report a certain odd occurrence. I would like you to meet Ms. Watson to get her full statement.

enter.say:
He isn't giving us a whole lot to go on, is he?
Okay, Ms. Watson is supposed to live in there. I've got a bluepill signal on my screen. No sign of any trouble.

talk.say: But...some other detectives were just here. I told them all about the glowing man already. Can't you just use their report?

done.say: That will do for now, {player}. Leave Ms. Watson and go outside, please.

phase.briefing:
We had sent no other units to contact Ms. Watson; those she spoke of must have been imposters--probably Zionites, eavesdropping on emergency calls.
We received a similar report while you were occupied with Ms. Watson. Signal analysis shows... Yes, a slightly weakened signal, indicative of a tapped line. I will have to conduct a review of our anti-wiretapping department...
You, {player}, will proceed to the call location. Your task is to intercept and disrupt the imposter team.

enter.say: I've got some unidentified redpill signals in there; must be the losers impersonating System operatives. Go get 'em!

done.say:
Okay then. Let that be a reminder to them not to impersonate System personnel.
I wonder what the heck we're after here, anyway. If Zion's after it too, then it's got to be something fairly important.
Hey, might as well ask that guy for his report, now that we've got him to ourselves.

talk.say:
I... Uh... I didn't know they were... I mean, I thought they were you. Uh...
Oh. O-okay. It was just that I saw this...thing out in the alley. Like...a neon robot--big, shaped like a big man. I-I don't know, it kind of hurt my eyes just looking at it. White sparks were shooting off of it. I think it saw me... It turned, and walked away down the alley. I was gonna follow it, but I...I guess I got kind of dizzy.

done.say:
A big neon man? I'd say that guy's crazy, but it's close to what Ms. Watson said. And if Zion's involved...
Well, we'd better report in to Gray. Maybe he'll be able to tell us what this is all about.

phase.briefing:
Yes, we are trying to track reports of an unusual individual. The reports you have heard are consistent with the description of the individual we are looking for. They have...caused some difficulties, and must be understood to be highly dangerous.
There has been another report in the area that we believe to be connected with the others. In this case, no name was given. You are to investigate the area thoroughly.

enter.say: I don't like the sound of this. What could this guy be? Someone who dredged up a cheat code? No, I don't even wanna go there.
Okay... It looks quiet in there. Nothing unusual, as far as I can see.
Hold on... Yeah... There's a deactivated Machine program in there. You're getting close to it. Why didn't Gray mention it?

done.say:
There he is. I-- Huh, I'm seeing traces of that code I couldn't identify earlier. And there's something weird about that dead program...
I'm not sure what to make of it. My scan isn't picking up anything else in the area, though.

mission.finish:
Thank you, {player}. That will be sufficient for now.
Hm... I should warn you that some System forces have been pulled back to protect core routines. This is related to the potential threat posed by the intruder you have been tracking. That is all I am permitted to communicate at this time.
